Abstract

摘要

Flexible dynamic operation of ammonia synthesis is a key enabling factor of green ammonia production in the face of intermittency in renewable energy sources. A nonlinear model predictive control scheme is presented in this paper for the Haber-Bosch ammonia synthesis process with a varying feed flowrate. The considered process consists of three interstage-cooled reactor beds and a flash separator, with a flexible reactor load varying between 50% and 100% of its nominal capacity. The proposed control scheme aims to control the reactor temperatures, separation pressure, and the liquid volume in the flash tank during feed transitions. A simulation study is performed given an assumed 5-hour feed schedule. The results indicate that all controlled variables are maintained in a safe operating range and tracked with small offsets in the nominal case as well as under disturbances in the reaction rate. It takes approximately 10 minutes for the reactor temperatures and 40 minutes for the separation pressure to reach steady state after a large step change in the reactor load. In the comparison with a PID control scheme, the investigated NMPC scheme tracks feed temperatures and the separation pressure significantly faster with less oscillations. This study therefore demonstrates the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed control scheme in enabling flexible operation of the process.

面对可再生能源的间歇性，合成氨过程的柔性动态运行是实现绿氨生产的关键因素。本文针对进料流量变化的 Haber-Bosch 合成氨过程，提出了一种非线性模型预测控制方案。所研究的过程由三个采用级间冷却的反应器床层和一个闪蒸分离器组成，反应器负荷可在其额定处理能力的 50% 至 100% 之间灵活变化。所提出的控制方案旨在进料切换过程中控制反应器温度、分离压力以及闪蒸罐内的液体体积。基于假定的 5 小时进料调度，开展了仿真研究。结果表明，在标称工况下以及反应速率受到扰动时，所有被控变量均保持在安全操作范围内，并以较小的偏差实现跟踪。反应器负荷发生较大阶跃变化后，反应器温度和分离压力达到稳态分别需要约 10 分钟和 40 分钟。与 PID 控制方案相比，所研究的 NMPC 方案对进料温度和分离压力的跟踪明显更快，振荡也更少。因此，本研究证明了所提出的控制方案在实现该过程柔性运行方面的可行性与有效性。

[AI补充·缩写] NMPC：nonlinear model predictive control，非线性模型预测控制；原文在第 1 节（PDF 第 2 页）给出全称。PID：proportional-integral-derivative，比例-积分-微分；本文未展开，依据 MathWorks 官方 PID 文档核实。此说明为 AI 添加，不属于上述原句。

Keywords: process control, green ammonia, nonlinear model predictive control

关键词：过程控制、绿氨、非线性模型预测控制

1. Introduction

1. 引言

Ammonia, a crucial chemical substance, is the second most produced chemical globally with an annual production amount of 176 million tons (David et al., 2020). Approximately 88% of ammonia produced is used as a fertilizer in agriculture, underscoring its significant role in this sector (Pattabathula and Richardson, 2016). Virtually all ammonia is synthesized through the Haber-Bosch process, in which nitrogen is converted to ammonia through a reaction with hydrogen at a temperature of 300-500 °C and a pressure around 200 bar (Erisman et al., 2008).

氨是一种重要的化学物质，也是全球产量第二大的化学品，年产量为 1.76 亿吨（David et al., 2020）。约 88% 的氨用作农业肥料，凸显了其在农业领域的重要作用（Pattabathula and Richardson, 2016）。几乎所有的氨都通过 Haber-Bosch 工艺合成；在该工艺中，氮气在 300-500 °C、约 200 bar 的条件下与氢气反应，转化为氨（Erisman et al., 2008）。

Ammonia production currently relies heavily on fossil fuels. Specifically, over 90% of hydrogen used in ammonia production is sourced from natural gas reforming or coal gasification (Pattabathula and Richardson, 2016), contributing to around 2% of global CO₂ emissions (Smith and Torrente-Murciano, 2023). Replacing this hydrogen with one produced via water electrolysis powered by renewable energy sources (RES) will be a key step towards decarbonizing agriculture. Ammonia produced using such renewable hydrogen is referred to as green ammonia, and its production and utilization are attracting worldwide attention currently by industry, private investors, and academia (Wang et al., 2022). In addition to its role in decarbonizing agriculture, green ammonia has tremendous potential as a medium for storing renewable energy. Chemical-based energy storage (compared to batteries and mechanical energy storage systems) is a promising way to resolve large mismatches between the supply and demand of renewable power and enable long duration storage and high storage capacity. Candidate chemicals for use as storage media include hydrogen, ammonia, methanol, and methane (Palys and Daoutidis, 2022). Ammonia has three times higher energy density than hydrogen and costs 10-100 times less to store than hydrogen (Salmon and Bañares-Alcántara, 2021). In addition, it is a carbon-free fuel. Due to these advantages, green ammonia has been proposed as an energy vector for many renewable energy systems (Du et al., 2022), such as sustainable agricultural systems (Palys et al., 2021), power distribution systems (Riley et al., 2023), microgrids (Kong et al., 2024), and energy hubs (Ghappani and Karimi, 2023).

目前，氨生产高度依赖化石燃料。具体而言，氨生产所用氢气中超过 90% 来自天然气重整或煤气化（Pattabathula and Richardson, 2016），由此产生的排放约占全球 CO₂ 排放量的 2%（Smith and Torrente-Murciano, 2023）。以利用可再生能源（RES）供电的水电解制氢替代上述氢气，将是推动农业脱碳的关键一步。利用这种可再生氢生产的氨称为绿氨，其生产与利用目前正受到全球工业界、私人投资者和学术界的关注（Wang et al., 2022）。除了有助于农业脱碳外，绿氨作为可再生能源储存介质也具有巨大潜力。与电池和机械储能系统相比，基于化学品的储能是一种有望解决可再生电力供需严重不匹配、并实现长时大容量储能的途径。可用作储能介质的候选化学品包括氢、氨、甲醇和甲烷（Palys and Daoutidis, 2022）。氨的能量密度为氢的三倍，而储存成本为氢的 1/10 至 1/100（Salmon and Bañares-Alcántara, 2021）。此外，氨是一种无碳燃料。由于这些优势，绿氨已被提出用作多种可再生能源系统的能源载体（Du et al., 2022），例如可持续农业系统（Palys et al., 2021）、配电系统（Riley et al., 2023）、微电网（Kong et al., 2024）以及能源枢纽（Ghappani and Karimi, 2023）。

Green ammonia production is likely to be powered by stand-alone renewable energy systems to ensure low carbon intensity in the electricity used. It will therefore be constrained by the availability of renewable power and consequently by the available inventory of hydrogen and nitrogen. Due to the intermittency of renewable power resources, ammonia production at a constant rate requires batteries and storage tanks to buffer fluctuations in the power supply and the feedstocks of hydrogen and nitrogen. Flexible ammonia production on the other hand, which largely follows the availability of RES, lends itself to significantly lower storage needs for hydrogen and/or power. An economic comparison between these two paradigms indicates that flexible operation leads to a significant reduction in the levelized cost of ammonia production (Palys and Daoutidis, 2023a) and is thus crucial for the economic viability of green ammonia production.

绿氨生产很可能由独立式可再生能源系统供电，以确保所用电力具有较低的碳强度。因此，绿氨生产将受到可再生电力可用性的限制，并进而受到可用氢气和氮气库存的限制。由于可再生电力资源具有间歇性，以恒定速率生产氨需要配置电池和储罐，以缓冲电力供应及氢、氮原料供应的波动。另一方面，柔性合成氨生产主要随 RES 的可用情况调整，因此可以显著降低对储氢和/或储电的需求。对这两种模式的经济性比较表明，柔性运行能够显著降低氨生产的平准化成本（Palys and Daoutidis, 2023a），因而对绿氨生产的经济可行性至关重要。

Flexible operation of air separation processes for nitrogen production has been well documented (Klein et al., 2021). Proton exchange membrane (PEM) electrolyzers also have a wide operating range (5% - 100% of the nominal capacity) with short response times (Boynuegri and Tekgun, 2023; Mucci et al., 2023), thus allowing for flexible production of hydrogen. The Haber-Bosch process however is operated at steady state in conventional plants, with only limited ramp-down capabilities from its nominal capacity (Fahr et al., 2023). Motivated by the need for flexible operation for green ammonia production, major ammonia technology companies have recently documented capabilities for dynamic operation over a wide operating range enabled by process control advancements. Casale has reported operation of ammonia synthesis plants at as low as 10% of their nominal capacities (Ostuni and Zardi, 2016) with ramping in the 10-100% range in the order of 30 minutes. Topsoe’s dynamic ammonia production technology features a load range of 10-100% and a ramp rate of at least 3% per minute (Topsoe, 2022). Stamicarbon is considering new plants operating in the 50%-100% load range. All of these reports of course are protected by patents and no details on the actual process control strategies employed are available in the open literature.

关于制氮空气分离过程的柔性运行，已有充分的文献记载（Klein et al., 2021）。质子交换膜（PEM）电解槽同样具有较宽的操作范围（额定处理能力的 5% - 100%）和较短的响应时间（Boynuegri and Tekgun, 2023; Mucci et al., 2023），因此能够实现柔性制氢。然而，传统工厂中的 Haber-Bosch 过程在稳态下运行，从额定处理能力向下降负荷的能力有限（Fahr et al., 2023）。受绿氨生产柔性运行需求的推动，主要合成氨技术公司近期公布了借助过程控制进展，在宽操作范围内实现动态运行的能力。Casale 报告称，合成氨工厂能够以低至额定处理能力 10% 的负荷运行（Ostuni and Zardi, 2016），并可在约 30 分钟的时间尺度内完成 10-100% 范围内的负荷调整。Topsoe 的动态合成氨技术具有 10-100% 的负荷范围，负荷变化速率至少为每分钟 3%（Topsoe, 2022）。Stamicarbon 正在考虑建设在 50%-100% 负荷范围内运行的新工厂。当然，这些报道涉及的技术均受到专利保护，公开文献中没有实际所用过程控制策略的详细信息。

Several design and scheduling studies incorporating flexible ammonia production have appeared (Palys and Daoutidis, 2023b,a). In Wu et al. (2024), capacity design and scheduling optimization of an electricity-hydrogen-ammonia system were investigated, in which various operating ranges and load adjustment rates of the ammonia synthesis system were evaluated. In Wen and Aziz (2022), a flexible operation strategy was adopted for a renewable multi-generation system with green hydrogen and ammonia production to satisfy the electricity needs of multiple cities; the dynamics of the ammonia synthesis process however was not explicitly considered. A study on the robust design and dynamic optimization of a flexible power-to-ammonia plant simulated the dynamic behavior of the Haber-Bosch process in Verleysen et al. (2023), yet a detailed control strategy was not discussed. Some older studies have focused on the regulatory control of the ammonia synthesis system (Araújo and Skogestad, 2008; Zhang et al., 2010) using linear controllers, without considering variations in the load. Without proper control during load changes, a reactor bed can overheat, deactivate the catalyst, or cool excessively, halting the reaction (Rosbo et al., 2023). In Rosbo et al. (2023), a PID control structure was used to stabilize the ammonia synthesis system for limited flexibility on the operation, with the reactor load allowed to vary by up to 10%.

已有若干设计与调度研究纳入了柔性合成氨生产（Palys and Daoutidis, 2023b,a）。Wu et al.（2024）研究了电-氢-氨系统的容量设计与调度优化，并评估了合成氨系统的不同操作范围和负荷调节速率。Wen and Aziz（2022）针对包含绿氢和氨生产的可再生能源多联产系统采用了柔性运行策略，以满足多个城市的用电需求；但该研究并未显式考虑合成氨过程的动态特性。Verleysen et al.（2023）关于柔性电制氨工厂鲁棒设计与动态优化的研究模拟了 Haber-Bosch 过程的动态行为，但没有讨论详细的控制策略。一些较早的研究采用线性控制器，关注合成氨系统的调节控制（Araújo and Skogestad, 2008; Zhang et al., 2010），而未考虑负荷变化。如果在负荷变化时缺乏适当控制，反应器床层可能过热并导致催化剂失活，也可能过度冷却而使反应停止（Rosbo et al., 2023）。Rosbo et al.（2023）采用 PID 控制结构，在有限的运行灵活性下稳定合成氨系统，允许反应器负荷最多变化 10%。

Evidently, very few studies have addressed the process control of the ammonia synthesis process under dynamic operation over a wide operating range. In this paper, we design and implement a plant-wide nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) scheme for the ammonia synthesis process with a flexible load that varies between 50% and 100% of the reactor’s nominal capacity. Our goal is to demonstrate the feasibility of efficient dynamic operation of the Haber-Bosch process for ammonia production and to motivate further research on this problem given its importance in the context of green ammonia production. The rest of this paper is structured as follows: the description and modeling of the process are discussed in Section 2; the control problem is stated in Section 3; the NMPC formulation is provided in Section 4; simulation results are presented and discussed in Section 5; and concluding remarks are provided in Section 6.

显然，针对宽操作范围动态运行下合成氨过程的过程控制，相关研究仍然很少。本文针对负荷可在反应器额定处理能力的 50% 至 100% 之间灵活变化的合成氨过程，设计并实现了一种全厂非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）方案。我们的目标是证明 Haber-Bosch 合成氨过程高效动态运行的可行性，并鉴于这一问题对绿氨生产的重要性，推动对该问题的进一步研究。本文其余部分安排如下：第 2 节讨论过程描述与建模；第 3 节陈述控制问题；第 4 节给出 NMPC 的数学表述；第 5 节展示并讨论仿真结果；第 6 节给出结论。

2. Process Description and Modeling

2. 过程描述与建模

The flowsheet of a Haber-Bosch process is shown in Figure 1; it consists of three adiabatic plug-flow reactor beds, two heat exchangers (HE-1, HE-2), two compressors (C1, C2), and a flash tank. Design parameters for the reactor beds and the flash tank, and the nominal operating conditions adopted from Rosbo et al. (2023); Zhang et al. (2010) are shown in Table 1.

图 1 所示为 Haber-Bosch 过程的流程图；该过程包括三个绝热活塞流反应器床层、两台换热器（HE-1、HE-2）、两台压缩机（C1、C2）和一个闪蒸罐。反应器床层与闪蒸罐的设计参数，以及取自 Rosbo et al.（2023）和 Zhang et al.（2010）的标称操作条件，列于表 1。

Figure 1: The process flowsheet of the ammonia synthesis system.

图 1：合成氨系统的工艺流程图。

The raw feed stream consisting of H₂ and N₂ (Stream 0) is first mixed with the recycle stream from the flash tank (Stream 6). After it is compressed to 200 bar by C2 and the temperature rises to 523 K, the total feed stream is split into four streams (Streams 1-4). Flowrates of Streams 1-4 are determined by the split ratios of the respective valves. Stream 1 is pre-heated by Stream 5 in the heat exchanger HE-1, then mixed with Stream 2, and fed to the first reactor bed. Interstage cooling is provided by direct mixing of cold synthesis gas (quenching stream) with the outlet stream from the previous reactor bed: the outlet stream of the first reactor bed is cooled by mixing with Stream 3 before fed to the second reactor bed, and the outlet stream from the second reactor bed is mixed with stream 4 before fed to the third reactor. Stream 5, as the output from the third reactor bed, is compressed to 196 bar by C1 and cooled to 313 K by heat exchanger HE-2 before fed to the flash tank, where ammonia is condensed and separated. The catalyst used in the reactor beds is metallic iron on Fe₃O₄, and its properties, adopted from Morud and Skogestad (1998), are shown in Table 2.

由 H₂ 和 N₂ 组成的新鲜进料流股（流股 0）首先与来自闪蒸罐的循环流股（流股 6）混合。混合后的总进料流股经 C2 压缩至 200 bar、温度升至 523 K 后，被分为四股（流股 1-4）。流股 1-4 的流量由各自阀门的分流比决定。流股 1 在换热器 HE-1 中由流股 5 预热，随后与流股 2 混合，并送入第一反应器床层。级间冷却通过将冷合成气（急冷流股）与上一反应器床层的出口流股直接混合来实现：第一反应器床层的出口流股与流股 3 混合冷却后进入第二反应器床层；第二反应器床层的出口流股与流股 4 混合后进入第三反应器。流股 5 为第三反应器床层的出口流股，经 C1 压缩至 196 bar，并由换热器 HE-2 冷却至 313 K 后进入闪蒸罐，氨在罐内冷凝并分离。反应器床层使用的催化剂为 Fe₃O₄ 上的金属铁，其性质取自 Morud and Skogestad（1998），见表 2。

The flash separation is assumed to be an isothermal process, in which ammonia is condensed at 313 K and 196 bar. The ammonia concentration in the liquid phase varies with the operating pressure: higher pressure leads to lower ammonia concentration, due to more hydrogen and nitrogen dissolved in the product (Araújo and Skogestad, 2008; Zhang et al., 2010; Lin et al., 2020). Given the separation pressure and temperature adopted in this work, the nominal ammonia concentration is 97.65 mol%. The nominal liquid volume is set to 30% of the total volume of the flash tank, with an acceptable range between 25% and 40% of the total volume. The production rate can be manipulated by adjusting the valve at the bottom of the flash tank. Another valve is set at the outlet of the vapor phase to regulate the recycle flowrate. Also, a purge valve is deployed to regulate the tank pressure. According to the nominal flash pressure (196 bar) and the feed pressure of the reactor (200 bar), the operating pressure range is set to be between 190 and 200 bar.

假定闪蒸分离为等温过程，氨在 313 K 和 196 bar 下冷凝。液相中的氨浓度随操作压力变化：压力越高，溶解在产品中的氢气和氮气越多，因此氨浓度越低（Araújo and Skogestad, 2008; Zhang et al., 2010; Lin et al., 2020）。在本文采用的分离压力和温度下，标称氨浓度为 97.65 mol%。标称液体体积设为闪蒸罐总体积的 30%，可接受范围为总体积的 25% 至 40%。可通过调节闪蒸罐底部的阀门来操纵生产速率。在气相出口另设一个阀门，以调节循环流量。此外，还设置了放空阀以调节罐内压力。根据标称闪蒸压力（196 bar）和反应器进料压力（200 bar），操作压力范围设为 190 至 200 bar。

In the modeling of the synthesis loop, some assumptions and simplifications are made. Compressors are not modeled; it is assumed that the streams fed to C1 and C2 can always be pressurized to the desired pressure. Also, the modeling of heat exchanger HE-2 is not considered. It is assumed that the cold utility used in HE-2 is sufficient to cool the hot stream to the nominal temperature (313 K).

在合成回路建模中，采用了一些假设和简化。不对压缩机建模；假定进入 C1 和 C2 的流股始终可以被加压至所需压力。此外，不考虑换热器 HE-2 的建模。假定 HE-2 所用的冷公用工程足以将热流股冷却至标称温度（313 K）。

In the scenario of our interest, the plant is connected to a fluctuating RES, and the feed flowrate schedule of hydrogen and nitrogen is specified at a supervisory level. It is assumed that the ratio of hydrogen and nitrogen in the feed stream is fixed at 3:1 on a molar basis. The feed flowrate is restricted to 50% - 100% of the nominal reactor capacity.

在我们关注的情景中，工厂与具有波动性的 RES 相连，氢气和氮气的进料流量调度由监督控制层指定。假定进料流股中氢气与氮气的摩尔比固定为 3:1。进料流量限制在反应器额定处理能力的 50% - 100% 范围内。

2.1. Reactor Model

2.1. 反应器模型

The reactor model is adopted from Morud and Skogestad (1998), in which the gas-phase holdup is neglected since the gas density is low. Each reactor bed is discretized in space to nn sections. Let ℐ:={1,2,3}\mathcal{I}:=\{1,2,3\} be the set of reactor beds and 𝒥:={1,2,...,n}\mathcal{J}:=\{1,2,...,n\} be the set of reactor sections. Then, ii denotes the index of reactor beds and jj denotes the index of reactor sections. The reaction rate (rijr_{ij}) is as follows:

反应器模型取自 Morud and Skogestad（1998）；由于气体密度较低，模型忽略气相持有量。将每个反应器床层在空间上离散为 nn 个区段。令 ℐ:={1,2,3}\mathcal{I}:=\{1,2,3\} 为反应器床层集合，𝒥:={1,2,...,n}\mathcal{J}:=\{1,2,...,n\} 为反应器区段集合。于是，ii 表示反应器床层的索引，jj 表示反应器区段的索引。反应速率（rijr_{ij}）如下：

2.3. 分离器模型

Vapor-liquid equilibrium (VLE) is assumed for the flash separation process: the distribution of ammonia in the vapor and liquid phase follows Raoult’s Law, while Henry’s Law is applied for the VLE calculations of hydrogen and nitrogen Gullberg (2018). Phase equilibrium equations are as follows:

3. Control Problem

3. 控制问题

In the operation of the ammonia synthesis plant, drastic oscillations in the reactor temperatures and overheating of the catalyst beds are undesirable as they may lead to detrimental catalyst deactivation (Rosbo et al., 2023). Also, frequent and drastic pressure changes in the reactor beds or the separator should be avoided, as they can cause fatigue stress to the vessels (Ostuni and Zardi, 2016). Since it is assumed that compressor C2 can always pressurize the feed stream to the desired pressure, the feed pressure is fixed at the nominal value (200 bar), thus the main control objectives are to control the reactor temperatures and the pressure in the flash tank. The liquid volume in the flash tank should also be controlled within the specified safety range (stated in Section 2).

在合成氨工厂运行过程中，应避免反应器温度剧烈振荡和催化剂床层过热，因为这些情况可能导致有害的催化剂失活（Rosbo et al., 2023）。此外，还应避免反应器床层或分离器中的压力频繁、剧烈变化，因为这会使容器承受疲劳应力（Ostuni and Zardi, 2016）。由于假定压缩机 C2 始终能够将进料流股加压至所需压力，进料压力固定为标称值（200 bar），因此主要控制目标是控制反应器温度和闪蒸罐内压力。闪蒸罐内的液体体积也应控制在规定的安全范围内（见第 2 节）。

Based on the process flowsheet in Figure 1, there are seven adjustable valves: four at the feed streams to the reactor beds and the heat exchanger, one at the bottom of the flash tank, one at the gas phase of the flash tank, and one at the purge splitter. It is natural to consider the corresponding variables, namely, the split ratios of the four feed valves, the gas phase output flowrate of the flash tank, the purge flowrate, and the production rate as the manipulated inputs 𝒖\boldsymbol u:

根据图 1 的工艺流程，共有七个可调阀门：四个位于通向反应器床层和换热器的进料流股上，一个位于闪蒸罐底部，一个位于闪蒸罐气相侧，另一个位于放空分流器处。因此，自然可以将相应变量，即四个进料阀门的分流比、闪蒸罐的气相出口流量、放空流量以及生产速率，作为操纵输入 𝒖\boldsymbol u：

排版说明：本式为英中共用，中文栏不再重复。

𝒖=[𝒓̃∈ℝ|𝒱|FvFpFl]⊤\boldsymbol u=[\widetilde{\boldsymbol r}\in\mathbb R^{|\mathcal V|}\quad F_v\quad F_p\quad F_l]^\top

(44)

Some discussion on the choice of controlled variables can be found in Zhang et al. (2010) and Araújo and Skogestad (2008), in which the feed temperatures of reactor beds, and the pressure and liquid volume in the separator are controlled. In our case, as no inert component (CH₄ or Ar) is contained in the synthesis gas, the recycle flowrate should also be controlled as close to the vapor outlet rate from the separator as possible to reduce the loss of synthesis gas. Moreover, when the reactor load changes significantly, the temperature along the whole reactor bed may not be stabilized by only controlling the feed temperature, thus, the end temperatures are also controlled. In summary, the controlled variables include: feed and end temperatures of the reactor beds (six in total), pressure in the separator, liquid volume in the separator, and the recycle flowrate. The vector of controlled variables 𝒙̂\widehat{\boldsymbol x} is then as follows:

Zhang et al.（2010）以及 Araújo and Skogestad（2008）对被控变量的选择作了一些讨论；这些研究控制反应器床层的进料温度，以及分离器内的压力和液体体积。在本文情形中，由于合成气不含惰性组分（CH₄ 或 Ar），还应控制循环流量，使其尽可能接近分离器的气相出口流量，以减少合成气损失。此外，当反应器负荷显著变化时，仅控制进料温度可能无法稳定整个反应器床层沿程的温度，因此还要控制床层末端温度。综上，被控变量包括：反应器床层的进料温度和末端温度（共六个）、分离器内压力、分离器内液体体积以及循环流量。因此，被控变量向量 𝒙̂\widehat{\boldsymbol x} 如下：

(45)

4. NMPC Formulation

4. NMPC 的数学表述

The overall control scheme is shown in Figure 2. The NMPC takes inputs of real-time measurements of the system states 𝒙init\boldsymbol x_{init} and the control actions 𝒖init\boldsymbol u_{init} from the ammonia synthesis plant, and the set points 𝒙sp\boldsymbol x^{sp} from the steady-state optimization layer (Eqs. 46 - 52). It is assumed that all state variables of the ammonia plant can be measured or accurately reconstructed through a state observer.

整体控制方案如图 2 所示。NMPC 的输入包括来自合成氨工厂的系统状态 𝒙init\boldsymbol x_{init} 和控制动作 𝒖init\boldsymbol u_{init} 的实时测量值，以及来自稳态优化层（式（46）-（52））的设定值 𝒙sp\boldsymbol x^{sp}。假定合成氨工厂的所有状态变量都可以被测量，或通过状态观测器准确重构。

The NMPC provides optimal control actions 𝒖*(tk)\boldsymbol u^*(t_k) by solving a dynamic optimization problem involving a set of differential-algebraic equations (DAEs) with a prediction time horizon of ℋ=[t0,tf]\mathcal H=[t_0,t_f], where ff represents the number of discrete time segments and tkt_k represents the kkth time instance. The dynamic optimization model is formed as follows:

NMPC 通过求解一个包含微分-代数方程组（DAEs）的动态优化问题，给出最优控制动作 𝒖*(tk)\boldsymbol u^*(t_k)；预测时域为 ℋ=[t0,tf]\mathcal H=[t_0,t_f]，其中 ff 表示离散时间段数，tkt_k 表示第 kk 个时刻。动态优化模型构建如下：

minimize最小化𝒖∑k=1fL(𝒙̂(tk),𝒙sp,𝒖(tk),𝒖(tk−1))\underset{\boldsymbol u}{\substack{\mathrm{minimize}\\\text{最小化}}}\quad\sum_{k=1}^fL(\widehat{\boldsymbol x}(t_k),\boldsymbol x^{sp},\boldsymbol u(t_k),\boldsymbol u(t_{k-1}))

(54)

4.1. Objective Function

4.1. 目标函数

The objective function in Eq. 54 is the sum of the loss functions over the prediction time horizon. The loss function L(⋅)L(\cdot) is formulated as follows:

式（54）中的目标函数是预测时域内各时刻损失函数之和。损失函数 L(⋅)L(\cdot) 表述如下：

排版说明：本式为英中共用，中文栏不再重复。

L=(𝒙̂−𝒙sp)⊤𝑸x(𝒙̂−𝒙sp)+(𝒖(tk)−𝒖(tk−1))⊤𝑸u((𝒖(tk)−𝒖(tk−1)),∀k=1,2,...,f\begin{aligned}L={}&(\widehat{\boldsymbol x}-\boldsymbol x^{sp})^\top\boldsymbol Q_x(\widehat{\boldsymbol x}-\boldsymbol x^{sp})\\&+(\boldsymbol u(t_k)-\boldsymbol u(t_{k-1}))^\top\boldsymbol Q_u((\boldsymbol u(t_k)-\boldsymbol u(t_{k-1})),\quad\forall k=1,2,...,f\end{aligned}

(63)

in which the first term corresponds to the deviations of the controlled variables from the set points, and the second term corresponds to the penalties on the manipulated inputs. The weight matrices 𝑸x\boldsymbol Q_x and 𝑸u\boldsymbol Q_u are positive semi-definite and diagonal, and they are tuned in the simulation case study in Section 5 to reduce offsets as much as possible while meeting all constraints. The entries in 𝑸x\boldsymbol Q_x and 𝑸u\boldsymbol Q_u corresponding to each controlled variable or manipulated input are shown in Table 5.

其中，第一项对应被控变量相对于设定值的偏差，第二项对应对操纵输入的惩罚。权重矩阵 𝑸x\boldsymbol Q_x 和 𝑸u\boldsymbol Q_u 均为半正定对角矩阵；在第 5 节的仿真案例研究中对其进行调节，以在满足全部约束的同时尽可能减小偏差。𝑸x\boldsymbol Q_x 和 𝑸u\boldsymbol Q_u 中与各被控变量或操纵输入对应的元素见表 5。

4.2. Ramping Constraints

4.2. 变化速率约束

Ramping constraints on the state variables (Eq. 56) and the manipulated inputs (Eq. 57) are also considered. The parameters 𝑪x\boldsymbol C_x are bounds for the ramping of state variables; 𝑪u−\boldsymbol C_u^- and 𝑪u+\boldsymbol C_u^+ are lower and upper bounds for the ramping of manipulated inputs, respectively. For the controlled variables, constraints aiming to prevent drastic temperature/pressure changes are as follows:

此外，还考虑了状态变量（式（56））和操纵输入（式（57））的变化速率约束。参数 𝑪x\boldsymbol C_x 为状态变量变化的界限；𝑪u−\boldsymbol C_u^- 和 𝑪u+\boldsymbol C_u^+ 分别为操纵输入变化的下界与上界。对于被控变量，为避免温度/压力剧烈变化，设置如下约束：

|Tgij(tk)−Tgij(tk−1)|≤5,∀k=1,2,...,f,i∈ℐ,j∈𝒥|Tg_{ij}(t_k)-Tg_{ij}(t_{k-1})|\leq5,\quad\forall k=1,2,...,f,\ i\in\mathcal I,\ j\in\mathcal J

(64)

|Tcij(tk)−Tcij(tk−1)|≤5,∀k=1,2,...,f,i∈ℐ,j∈𝒥|Tc_{ij}(t_k)-Tc_{ij}(t_{k-1})|\leq5,\quad\forall k=1,2,...,f,\ i\in\mathcal I,\ j\in\mathcal J

(65)

Eq. 64 and Eq. 65 state that the temperature changes of the synthesis gas and catalyst particles in reactor beds in neighbouring time instances can not be greater than 5 K; Eq. 66 states that the pressure change in the separator in adjacent time instances can not be greater than 1 bar.

式（64）和式（65）规定，反应器床层中合成气和催化剂颗粒在相邻时刻的温度变化不能超过 5 K；式（66）规定，分离器内压力在相邻时刻的变化不能超过 1 bar。

Among the manipulated inputs, it is intuitive to have faster adjustment of the split ratios of the quenching streams to stabilize the reactor temperature, whereas the vapor-phase outlet flowrate of the flash tank and the purge flowrate should not change equally fast as it can cause drastic temperature and pressure oscillations. Also, the production rate ramping should be constrained to ensure smooth transitions and reduce fluctuations. Thus it is assumed that the split ratios (𝒓̃\widetilde{\boldsymbol r}) of the quenching streams at the next time instance can be 80% - 120% of the current value, whereas the remaining manipulated variables are only allowed to vary between 90% and 110% of their current values:

在各操纵输入中，直观上应较快调整急冷流股的分流比，以稳定反应器温度；而闪蒸罐气相出口流量和放空流量不应以同样快的速度变化，否则会引起剧烈的温度和压力振荡。此外，还应约束生产速率的变化，以确保平稳切换并减少波动。因此，假定急冷流股下一时刻的分流比（𝒓̃\widetilde{\boldsymbol r}）可为当前值的 80% - 120%，而其余操纵变量仅允许在当前值的 90% 至 110% 之间变化：

4.3. Initial and Terminal Conditions

4.3. 初始条件与终端条件

Initial conditions for state variables and control actions are stated in Eqs. 60 and 61, respectively. Initial values 𝒙init\boldsymbol x_{init} and 𝒖init\boldsymbol u_{init} are obtained from real-time measurements at the ammonia plant, and are assigned to 𝒙(0)\boldsymbol x(0) and 𝒖(0)\boldsymbol u(0). Furthermore, as shown in Eq. 62, a terminal condition is applied to the liquid volume in the separator, which is the nominal volume defined for the process.

状态变量和控制动作的初始条件分别由式（60）和式（61）给出。初始值 𝒙init\boldsymbol x_{init} 和 𝒖init\boldsymbol u_{init} 由合成氨工厂的实时测量获得，并赋给 𝒙(0)\boldsymbol x(0) 和 𝒖(0)\boldsymbol u(0)。此外，如式（62）所示，对分离器中的液体体积施加终端条件，使其等于为该过程规定的标称体积。

5. Simulation

5. 仿真

5.1. Simulation Setup

5.1. 仿真设置

A simulation of the flexible ammonia synthesis process described in Section 2 with the NMPC scheme formulated in Section 4 was implemented. Designs, operating conditions, and catalyst properties are provided in Tables 1-2, and any other parameters are shown in Table B.9 in the Appendix B.

采用第 4 节建立的 NMPC 方案，对第 2 节描述的柔性合成氨过程进行了仿真。设计信息、操作条件和催化剂性质见表 1-2，其余参数见附录 B 的表 B.9。

Given the full-load feed flowrate of 600 mol/s, an assumed feed schedule is set for a 5-hour time horizon, in which the feed flowrate varies once per hour: the feed flowrate starts at 304 mol/s, increases to 504 mol/s in the next hour, then decreases to 477 mol/s and 316 mol/s in the next two step changes, and it finally increases to 572 mol/s. The feed profile is provided in Table 6.

满负荷进料流量为 600 mol/s，在此基础上设定一个假定的 5 小时进料调度，进料流量每小时变化一次：进料流量从 304 mol/s 开始，下一小时增加至 504 mol/s，随后两次阶跃变化分别降至 477 mol/s 和 316 mol/s，最后增加至 572 mol/s。进料变化过程见表 6。

As stated in Section 3, Gaussian disturbances are added to the reaction rates. Three different values are considered for the standard deviation σ\sigma in Eq. 53: σ1=0\sigma_1=0 (disturbance-free), σ2=0.1rNH3\sigma_2=0.1\,r_{NH_3}, and σ3=0.2rNH3\sigma_3=0.2\,r_{NH_3}.

如第 3 节所述，在反应速率上叠加高斯扰动。对式（53）中的标准差 σ\sigma 考虑三个不同取值：σ1=0\sigma_1=0（无扰动）、σ2=0.1rNH3\sigma_2=0.1\,r_{NH_3} 和 σ3=0.2rNH3\sigma_3=0.2\,r_{NH_3}。

The NMPC is implemented with the Python package Pyomo (Hart et al., 2011; Bynum et al., 2021). The source codes of the NMPC scheme, along with the simulation model are available on Github: https://github.com/ddolab/AmmoniaSynCtrl. The prediction time horizon is set to be 180 seconds, and the Backward Euler method is used to discretize the model in time with a 10-second discretization step, based on which f=180/10=18f=180/10=18. The resulting nonlinear program (NLP) that consists of 7638 variables among which 1134 are differential state variables and the remainder are algebraic varibales, 7525 equality constraints, and 2488 inequality constraints is solved by IPOPT (Wächter and Biegler, 2006). The variables are initialized with values from the previous prediction result or from the steady-state optimization. Note that when an optimal solution to the prediction problem is not obtained, the control inputs returned by the solver are still adopted.

NMPC 使用 Python 软件包 Pyomo 实现（Hart et al., 2011; Bynum et al., 2021）。NMPC 方案的源代码及仿真模型可在 Github 获取：https://github.com/ddolab/AmmoniaSynCtrl。预测时域设为 180 秒，采用后向欧拉法，以 10 秒为离散步长对模型进行时间离散，因此 f=180/10=18f=180/10=18。所得非线性规划（NLP）包含 7638 个变量，其中 1134 个为微分状态变量，其余为代数变量，另有 7525 个等式约束和 2488 个不等式约束；该问题采用 IPOPT 求解（Wächter and Biegler, 2006）。变量采用上一次预测结果或稳态优化结果中的值进行初始化。需要注意的是，当未能获得预测问题的最优解时，仍采用求解器返回的控制输入。

[AI补充·缩写] IPOPT：Interior Point Optimizer，内点优化求解器。本文未展开名称；依据 COIN-OR 的 Ipopt 官方文档核实。此说明为 AI 添加，不属于上述原句。

5.2. NMPC Results

5.2. NMPC 结果

The temperature profiles at the inlet and outlet of each reactor bed are shown in Figures 3 and 4 as solid lines, whereas the dashed lines represent the corresponding set points. All temperatures are well maintained within a safe operating range (i.e., between 600 K and 900 K), ensuring that the reactor beds neither cool down excessively nor experience catalyst deactivation. Optimal temperatures (set points) vary depending on the feed flowrate, with the maximum increase in a single step being approximately 45 K. The controller is able to bring the temperatures close to the corresponding set points smoothly within approximately 10 minutes following a step change in the feed flowrate, though small offsets exist. The offsets are most likely due to the different discretizations of the ODEs when solving the prediction NLP problem and simulating the plant. Comparing across the three scenarios with different disturbance levels, slight temperature fluctuations are observed when the standard deviation increases from 0 to σ2\sigma_2, and the fluctuations are significantly larger when the standard deviation is set to σ3\sigma_3. Despite these fluctuations, the inlet and outlet temperatures are still controlled near their set points in all the cases.

各反应器床层入口和出口的温度变化曲线分别以实线显示于图 3 和图 4，虚线表示相应的设定值。所有温度均维持在安全操作范围内（即 600 K 至 900 K），确保反应器床层既不会过度冷却，也不会发生催化剂失活。最优温度（设定值）随进料流量而变化，单次阶跃的最大增幅约为 45 K。进料流量发生阶跃变化后，控制器能够在约 10 分钟内使温度平稳接近相应设定值，但仍存在小偏差。这些偏差很可能源于求解预测 NLP 问题与模拟工厂时，对 ODEs 采用了不同的离散化方式。比较三个不同扰动水平的情景可见，当标准差从 0 增大至 σ2\sigma_2 时，温度出现轻微波动；当标准差设为 σ3\sigma_3 时，波动明显增大。尽管存在这些波动，在所有情形下，入口和出口温度仍被控制在设定值附近。

Figure 5 shows the profile of the pressure in the separator, along with the recycle flowrate and purge flowrate that have significant influence on the pressure. The pressure is well maintained within the desired operating range (190-200 bar) and is controlled near the nominal operating pressure of 196 bar. The pressure increases when the feed flowrate ramps up, and it drops when the feed flowrate ramps down. It takes up to 40 minutes for the pressure to reach steady state after a step change in the reactor load, which is slower than the temperature transitions. This is due to the relatively strict constraints set for the ramping of the recycle flowrate to avoid drastic pressure and temperature fluctuations. It is also evident that the purge flowrate increases to reduce the pressure in the separator when it gets close to the upper bound, and is maintained near zero when the plant is at steady state. When the disturbances increase, larger fluctuations in the pressure are observed, resulting in more frequent adjustments of the recycle flowrate to stabilize the pressure. Still, the offset of the pressure is not completely eliminated.

图 5 显示了分离器内压力的变化曲线，以及对该压力有显著影响的循环流量和放空流量。压力保持在期望的操作范围（190-200 bar）内，并被控制在标称操作压力 196 bar 附近。进料流量上升时，压力增大；进料流量下降时，压力降低。反应器负荷发生阶跃变化后，压力达到稳态最长需要 40 分钟，慢于温度的过渡过程。这是因为，为避免剧烈的压力和温度波动，对循环流量的变化设置了较严格的约束。还可以明显看出，当分离器内压力接近上界时，放空流量增大，以降低压力；工厂处于稳态时，放空流量则保持在零附近。当扰动增大时，压力波动也更大，因此需要更频繁地调整循环流量，以稳定压力。不过，压力偏差仍未完全消除。

The ammonia production rate and the ammonia concentration in the product stream are shown in Figure 6. It is interesting to note that even though the production rate is not directly controlled, by controlling other state variables such as temperatures in the reactor beds and the pressure of the separator, the actual production rate stays very close to the optimal production rate obtained from the steady-state optimization. No fluctuation of the production rate is observed when the disturbance increases, as it is directly manipulated. When the feed flowrate changes, the transition between production rates takes up to 20 minutes. The transitions are smooth and the production rate profile is steady after the transitions, due to the penalties on the ramping of the production rate. The mole fraction of ammonia in the product varies slightly around the nominal concentration 0.9765, and is in the range of 0.9760 – 0.9768, depending on the separation pressure. The quality of the product, i.e. the ammonia concentration, is acceptable considering the reference values of 0.96 and 0.99 reported in Zhang et al. (2010) and Lin et al. (2020), respectively. Minor fluctuations appear in the ammonia concentration when the disturbance increases. Transitions of the ammonia concentration between steady states are slower than that of the production rate, due to the slow pressure changes in the flash tank.

图 6 显示了氨生产速率和产品流股中的氨浓度。值得关注的是，尽管没有直接控制生产速率，通过控制反应器床层温度、分离器压力等其他状态变量，实际生产速率仍非常接近稳态优化得到的最优生产速率。由于生产速率被直接操纵，扰动增大时并未观察到生产速率波动。进料流量变化时，生产速率之间的切换最长需要 20 分钟。由于对生产速率变化施加了惩罚，切换过程平稳，切换后的生产速率曲线也保持稳定。产品中氨的摩尔分数在标称浓度 0.9765 附近小幅变化，随分离压力而异，处于 0.9760–0.9768 范围内。考虑到 Zhang et al.（2010）和 Lin et al.（2020）分别报告的参考值 0.96 和 0.99，该产品质量，即氨浓度，是可以接受的。扰动增大时，氨浓度出现轻微波动。由于闪蒸罐内压力变化较慢，氨浓度在不同稳态之间的切换慢于生产速率的切换。

5.3. Comparison with PID Control

5.3. 与 PID 控制的比较

To further evaluate the control performance of the proposed NMPC scheme, a PID control structure adopted from Araújo and Skogestad (2008); Zhang et al. (2010) is implemented as a reference. The PID control structure is shown in Figure 7, where PI controllers are deployed to track feed temperatures of reactor beds and the pressure in the separator, while a P controller is used to regulate liquid volume in the flash tank. The purge valve is opened if the actual vapor output flowrate of the separator can not be increased to the value specified by the controller in time, due to the ramping constraints applied to the recycle valve. The PID scheme is implemented in Simulink 2024a, where controller parameters are tuned via the built-in tuning functionality. Details of the controlled variables with the corrsponding manipulated inputs and controller parameters are shown in Table 7.

为进一步评估所提出 NMPC 方案的控制性能，实现了一个取自 Araújo and Skogestad（2008）及 Zhang et al.（2010）的 PID 控制结构作为参照。PID 控制结构如图 7 所示，其中采用 PI 控制器跟踪反应器床层的进料温度和分离器内压力，采用 P 控制器调节闪蒸罐内液体体积。如果由于循环阀所受的变化速率约束，分离器的实际气相出口流量无法及时增加至控制器指定值，则打开放空阀。PID 方案在 Simulink 2024a 中实现，控制器参数通过其内置整定功能进行整定。被控变量、相应操纵输入及控制器参数的详细信息见表 7。

The PID control structure is first tested with the feed flowrate profile shown in Table 6; however, the separation pressure and the temperature of reactors can not be stabilized in one hour after a drastic change of the feed flowrate. Thus, the time periods for each feed flowrate (except the first one) are extended from 1 hour to 1.5 hour, as shown in Table 8. Other parameters such as equipment sizes, catalyst properties, and initial temperatures and pressures are consistent with those described in Section 2. To make a fair comparison, the NMPC scheme is also tested with the same feed flowrate profile. Disturbances in the reaction rates are not considered.

首先采用表 6 所示的进料流量变化过程测试 PID 控制结构；然而，在进料流量剧烈变化后的一小时内，分离压力和反应器温度无法稳定。因此，将各进料流量的持续时间（第一段除外）从 1 小时延长至 1.5 小时，如表 8 所示。设备尺寸、催化剂性质以及初始温度和压力等其他参数均与第 2 节所述一致。为进行公平比较，也采用相同的进料流量变化过程测试 NMPC 方案。此处不考虑反应速率扰动。

The comparison of feed temperatures of the reactor beds is shown in Figure 8. The PI controllers manage to track the set points with zero offsets; however, significant oscillations that can be detrimental to the catalysts are observed, especially after a large step increase of the feed flowrate at the 330th minute. In contrast, the NMPC results show no or little temperature oscillations despite the small offsets, and the temperatures reach steady state at least 3 times faster than the those obtained from the PID control scheme. Separation pressures in the NMPC result and the PID control result are shown in Figure 9. The PI controller tracks the reference pressure in 60 - 80 minutes after a large step change in the feed flowrate, which is significantly longer than the time required by the NMPC. The production flowrate and ammonia concentration in the product are shown in Figure 10. Both control schemes adjust the production flowrate as a manipulated variable which stays at the optimal value after a steady state is reached. However, in the PID control, more fluctuations are observed in the production flowrate profile and it takes longer to have a steady product output after a 43% feed flowrate increase at the 330th minute. The ammonia purity in the product is acceptable in both cases, while in the NMPC it exhibits less variance due to faster tracking of the separation pressure. Overall, the NMPC scheme outperforms the PID control scheme in terms of the temperature/pressure tracking speed and the transition smoothness, though minor offsets (less than 1% of the set points) may exist.

反应器床层进料温度的比较见图 8。PI 控制器能够实现对设定值的零偏差跟踪；但可以观察到可能损害催化剂的明显振荡，尤其是在第 330 分钟进料流量大幅阶跃增加之后。相比之下，尽管 NMPC 结果存在小偏差，但几乎没有或完全没有温度振荡，而且温度达到稳态的速度至少为 PID 控制方案的 3 倍。NMPC 与 PID 控制结果中的分离压力见图 9。进料流量发生较大阶跃变化后，PI 控制器需要 60 - 80 分钟才能跟踪到参考压力，明显长于 NMPC 所需时间。图 10 显示了产品流量和产品中的氨浓度。两种控制方案都将产品流量作为操纵变量进行调整，并在达到稳态后使其保持在最优值。但在 PID 控制中，产品流量曲线的波动更多；在第 330 分钟进料流量增加 43% 后，需要更长时间才能获得稳定的产品输出。两种情形下的产品氨纯度均可接受，而 NMPC 由于对分离压力的跟踪更快，氨纯度的变动更小。总体而言，NMPC 方案在温度/压力跟踪速度和切换平稳性方面优于 PID 控制方案，但可能存在小偏差（低于设定值的 1%）。

6. Conclusions

6. 结论

In this work, an NMPC scheme for the control of a flexible ammonia production system is proposed and tested. A feed schedule in which the feed flowrate varies between 50% and 100% of the nominal value is assumed for a 5-hour time horizon. The simulations demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed control scheme. Results show that all the controlled variables are maintained in a safe operating range and tracked near the corresponding set points, with small offsets. The transitions of reactor temperatures take around 10 minutes, and it takes around 40 minutes for the pressure in the flash tank to reach a steady state for a large step change in the feed flowrate. When normally distributed disturbances are introduced to the reaction rate, minor fluctuations are observed in both the profiles of the reactor temperature and the separation pressure. The production rate, on the other hand, is not affected by these disturbances as it is directly manipulated, and it stays close to the optimal values dictated by the steady-state optimization. The ammonia concentration in the product is between 97.60% and 97.68%, which is close to the nominal value of 97.65%. Compared to a PID control scheme, the NMPC tracks the temperatures and the pressure significantly faster, and a smoother transition in the production flowrate is also observed.

本研究提出并测试了一种用于柔性合成氨生产系统控制的 NMPC 方案。假定了一个 5 小时时域内的进料调度，其中进料流量在标称值的 50% 至 100% 之间变化。仿真证明了所提出控制方案的可行性。结果表明，所有被控变量均维持在安全操作范围内，并跟踪至相应设定值附近，但存在小偏差。反应器温度的过渡约需 10 分钟；当进料流量发生较大阶跃变化时，闪蒸罐内压力达到稳态约需 40 分钟。在反应速率中引入正态分布扰动后，反应器温度与分离压力曲线均出现轻微波动。另一方面，由于生产速率被直接操纵，它不受这些扰动影响，并保持在稳态优化确定的最优值附近。产品中的氨浓度介于 97.60% 与 97.68% 之间，接近标称值 97.65%。与 PID 控制方案相比，NMPC 对温度和压力的跟踪明显更快，产品流量的切换也更加平稳。

In all, the proposed NMPC strategy is demonstrated to work well for the considered flexible ammonia synthesis process, under the assumption that all variables are measured accurately and are noise-free. Future research efforts will focus on addressing the control problem under realistic measurements of the state variables and addressing the control of the process over a wider operating range (e.g. 10%-100% reactor load variation).

总体而言，在假定所有变量均得到准确测量且不含噪声的条件下，所提出的 NMPC 策略已被证明能有效控制所研究的柔性合成氨过程。未来研究将重点解决在状态变量的实际测量条件下的控制问题，并研究更宽操作范围内的过程控制（例如反应器负荷在 10%-100% 之间变化）。
